summary.intent: Manage active milestone phases using the GSD workflow manager: merge completed PRs, clean up stale worktrees, execute Phase 30 (Web App Observability), plan/execute Phase 31 (Structural Decomposition), discuss/plan Phase 32 (FUSE Async FilePointer), add Phase 33 (Windows WinFsp) to roadmap, and resolve all PR review comments.
summary.outcome: Phases 28 and 29 PRs merged; Phase 30 executed, simplified, and PR #386 created with review comments addressed; Phase 31 planned, executed, and simplified (3-hook split of useSharedNavigation); Phase 32 discussed and planned (3 plans across 2 waves); Phase 33 added to roadmap with PR #385; stale worktrees cleaned up and ROADMAP.md merge conflicts resolved.

repo: ROADMAP.md is the authoritative source during merges — always take origin/main's version when conflicts arise in .planning/ files
Worktrees accumulate stale entries after PRs merge and need explicit removal via `git worktree remove`
The GSD workflow manager reads disk state on each dashboard refresh, so merging main and cleaning worktrees is required to see accurate phase status
Phase 30 (Faro) defers registerFaroTransport wiring to main.tsx until Phase 28 logger module ships — the export is ready but the call site is not wired
SMB backend is the active FUSE-T backend (NFS dropped due to unfixable macOS kernel bug) — FUSE work is macOS-only
GitHub environment variables VITE_FARO_URL, GRAFANA_FARO_API_KEY, GRAFANA_STACK_ID must be configured in staging before Faro activates
The `scripts/check-api-client.sh` git diff check is intentional — it cannot detect if api:generate was never run, only if it was run and output not staged
bin.service.ts is already deprecated with only 2 consumers; SDK equivalents exist — D-09/D-15 deferred from Phase 31
Pre-existing type errors in SDK test mocks (35 errors across 4 files) existed before Phase 31 — not introduced by Phase 31 changes

code.finding: drain_refresh_completions() calls block_with_timeout per FilePointer on the FUSE thread — blocks up to 10s per file during IPNS resolve, causing Finder 'connection lost' errors under load. Phase 32 will replace with channel-based async mirroring the existing PendingContent pattern.

unenrollIpns() returned void — totalUnenrolled in unenrollBatch() overcounted because it incremented even when nothing was deleted. Fixed to return affected row count so unenrollBatch() sums actual deletions.

Faro privacy scrubbing originally missed arrays (scrubObject only handled plain objects), didn't scrub item.meta, didn't include 'email' in SENSITIVE_KEYS, and returned raw objects at depth > 3 instead of a placeholder. All fixed in PR review pass.
maxDataPoints was 100, inconsistent with db-fallback-rate.json which uses 43200 (1 point/2s over 24h). Aligned to 43200.

1206-line monolith split into 3 hooks to meet <400 lines each: orchestrator (378 lines) + useSharedNavigationActions (478 lines) + useSharedWriteOps (378 lines). The split required 3 hooks not 2 due to the line constraint.

ShareKeyCache used weak string typing for key type — strengthened to ShareKeyType. Also lacked proactive pruneExpired() method; added to allow callers to trigger cleanup rather than relying solely on get() lazy pruning.

workflow: When gh CLI replies to PR review comments, use `--field in_reply_to=COMMENT_ID` (integer field) not `-f` — REST API requires integer type
GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation can batch multiple thread resolutions in a single call
The /simplify skill launches 3 parallel agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) and aggregates findings — effective at catching duplicated context transforms and missing type specificity
Phase execution in worktrees produces branches like worktree-agent-XXXX that need to be fetched or PRs created before cleaning up the worktree
Cherry-picking context/docs commits across branches is the cleanest way to consolidate planning artifacts when docs and execution land on different branches
Independent phases with no file overlap can safely execute in parallel without waiting for each other to merge

friction: Phase 29 worktree (agent-a207a299) persisted after PR #383 merged — had to manually detect staleness by cross-referencing git log against main
Branch checkout was silently switched during worktree cleanup, causing edits to appear missing until the correct directory was identified
ROADMAP.md merge conflicts recurred across multiple merges — the progress table and phase status sections frequently conflict when multiple branches add completion markers
Phase 31 execution landed on a worktree branch (worktree-agent-a7d4653c) rather than the expected phase-31 branch, requiring cherry-pick or fetch to get changes into the main working branch
Pre-existing test type errors (35 errors in 4 SDK test files) surfaced during typecheck — not caused by Phase 31 but blocked clean typecheck verification
GSD manager dashboard showed Phase 30 as 'Ready to execute' even after execution because the execution was on a worktree branch not yet merged into the phase-31 branch
